# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 19
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 19

---

**19:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and to preach.

---

**The Gospel according to Mary.**

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* Unanimous across all three agents. The gospel closes on mission. The colophon is canonical. LOGOS' form adopted. The Gospel of Mary is complete.
